arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m. Hot start drained the reserve; weed on rudder about 7.3-8.6 min, cleared by back-stroke at 8.6 min. From 2000 m: hold pod power about 205 W (pod sustainable), pace about 150-152 over ground in clean water (paddler tends to run faster than cued, so cue a touch slow). Keep pod reserve from falling below about 10 pct before 1000 m to go. At 1000 m to go judge reserve: build gradually; finish sprint from about 300-400 m. Weed signature seen: push_local falls about 0.1 m/s (to -0.05) while speed_vs_early drops 5-7 pct at steady pod power and paddler says heavy. Watch for radio course changes and pod drift.

Legs: 1000 m out (north) and back (south); turn 4 at 4000 m, leg 5 north, turn 5 at 5000 m, leg 6 south, turn 6 at 6000 m, leg 7 north to finish 7000 m.
